programme.desc: Sports Illustrated’s Pat Forde and Bryan Fischer are joined by former longtime College Gameday reporter Gene Wojciechowski to discuss the latest in College Football. They also give their opinions on Tulane and JMU and whether the outrage surrounding their performances has become too much.
